integrity: The result contains a symbolic proof for all admissible attenuation parameters and a standalone exact-rational finite checker. The source already exhibits the same graph shape for a different nonlinear utility; novelty is confined to the Katz heterogeneous-cost threshold and sharp size boundary. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
limitations: The least cost-dispersion formula supports one four-player graph architecture, not every equilibrium graph. Near-homogeneity occurs as Katz attenuation tends to zero; neither fixed-attenuation arbitrarily small dispersion nor an unrestricted structural classification follows. The model uses undirected links created by either sponsor, positive player-specific linear costs, and walk-sum Katz benefit. Literature priority is not independently certified.
title: Four-agent breakdown of core–periphery structure under arbitrarily small Katz link-cost heterogeneity
